outgoing.en: My best friend is really outgoing and can talk to anyone at a party.
outgoing.zh: 我最好的朋友特别外向,在派对上能和任何人聊天。

sociable.en: I'm quite sociable, so I enjoy meeting new people at work.
sociable.zh: 我挺好交际的,所以喜欢在工作中结识新朋友。

reserved.en: My dad is a bit reserved, but he's very kind once you know him.
reserved.zh: 我爸爸有点内敛,但熟悉之后你会发现他很和善。

shy.en: I was quite shy as a kid, so I rarely spoke up in class.
shy.zh: 我小时候挺害羞的,所以在课堂上很少发言。

easy-going.en: My boss is very easy-going and never gets angry about small mistakes.
easy-going.zh: 我的老板很随和,从不为小错误生气。

laid-back.en: People in my hometown are pretty laid-back and never seem to hurry.
laid-back.zh: 我家乡的人都挺悠闲的,好像从来不着急。

considerate.en: My neighbour is so considerate that she always turns her music down at night.
considerate.zh: 我的邻居特别体贴,晚上总会把音乐调小。

thoughtful.en: It was really thoughtful of my friend to remember my mum's birthday.
thoughtful.zh: 我的朋友记得我妈妈的生日,真是太体贴了。

generous.en: My uncle is very generous and always pays when we go out for dinner.
generous.zh: 我叔叔很慷慨,我们出去吃饭总是他付钱。

selfish.en: I think it's a bit selfish to play loud music late at night.
selfish.zh: 我觉得深夜大声放音乐有点自私。

modest.en: Even though she's won lots of prizes, my friend is very modest about it.
modest.zh: 虽然我朋友得过很多奖,但她对此很谦虚。

modest.en: We live in a modest flat, but it's enough for the two of us.
modest.zh: 我们住在一套不大的公寓里,但对我们两人来说够了。

humble.en: He's a famous doctor, but he's really humble and friendly with everybody.
humble.zh: 他是一位名医,但待人特别谦逊友好。

arrogant.en: I don't like people who are arrogant about how much money they have.
arrogant.zh: 我不喜欢那些因为有钱就傲慢的人。

honest.en: To me, the most important thing in a friend is being honest.
honest.zh: 对我来说,朋友最重要的品质是诚实。

sincere.en: She's a very sincere person, and I always believe what she says.
sincere.zh: 她是一个非常真诚的人,我总是相信她说的话。

trustworthy.en: I'd only lend money to someone I know is really trustworthy.
trustworthy.zh: 我只会把钱借给确实值得信赖的人。

responsible.en: My older cousin is very responsible and always looks after the younger kids.
responsible.zh: 我的表哥很负责任,总是照顾年纪小的孩子。

diligent.en: My classmate is so diligent that she checks every homework question twice.
diligent.zh: 我的同学特别认真,每道作业题都检查两遍。

hard-working.en: My parents are both hard-working people who taught me the value of money.
hard-working.zh: 我父母都是勤奋的人,他们教会了我金钱的价值。

industrious.en: My grandparents were industrious farmers who got up before sunrise every day.
industrious.zh: 我的祖父母是勤劳的农民,每天日出前就起床。

ambitious.en: I'm quite ambitious, and I hope to run my own company one day.
ambitious.zh: 我挺有抱负的,希望有一天能经营自己的公司。

determined.en: I was determined to pass my driving test, even after failing it twice.
determined.zh: 即使考了两次都没过,我还是下定决心要通过驾照考试。

persistent.en: You have to be persistent if you want to learn a musical instrument.
persistent.zh: 想学乐器就得坚持不懈。

patient.en: My piano teacher is incredibly patient and never gets tired of helping me.
patient.zh: 我的钢琴老师特别有耐心,从不厌烦帮助我。

optimistic.en: I'm generally optimistic and try to see the good side of things.
optimistic.zh: 我总体上很乐观,尽量看到事情好的一面。

pessimistic.en: I try not to be pessimistic, even when things aren't going very well.
pessimistic.zh: 即使事情不太顺利,我也尽量不悲观。

cheerful.en: My roommate is always cheerful, even early in the morning.
cheerful.zh: 我的室友总是很开朗,就连大清早也一样。

humorous.en: My favourite teacher was very humorous, so her lessons were never boring.
humorous.zh: 我最喜欢的老师很幽默,所以她的课从不无聊。

witty.en: He's so witty that everyone laughs whenever he tells a story.
witty.zh: 他特别风趣,每次讲故事大家都会笑。

curious.en: I've always been curious about how people live in other countries.
curious.zh: 我一直对其他国家的人怎样生活感到好奇。

open-minded.en: Travelling abroad has made me much more open-minded about other cultures.
open-minded.zh: 出国旅行让我对其他文化的态度开明多了。

narrow-minded.en: I think it's narrow-minded to judge people by the way they dress.
narrow-minded.zh: 我觉得以衣着评判别人是心胸狭窄的表现。

independent.en: Living away from home at university made me a lot more independent.
independent.zh: 上大学离家生活让我独立多了。

mature.en: My friend is very mature for her age and gives really good advice.
mature.zh: 我朋友比同龄人成熟得多,总能给出很好的建议。

sensible.en: My dad is a very sensible person, so I always ask him for advice.
sensible.zh: 我爸爸是个很明智的人,所以我总是向他请教。

sensitive.en: I'm quite sensitive, so I often get upset by what people say.
sensitive.zh: 我挺敏感的,所以常常因为别人的话而难过。

calm.en: My mum stays calm even when something goes badly wrong at home.
calm.zh: 即使家里出了大问题,我妈妈也能保持冷静。

energetic.en: My little nephew is so energetic that he never seems to get tired.
energetic.zh: 我的小侄子精力特别充沛,好像从来不会累。

enthusiastic.en: Our new coach is really enthusiastic, which makes training a lot more fun.
enthusiastic.zh: 我们的新教练特别热情,这让训练有趣多了。

passionate.en: She's passionate about teaching and spends her weekends preparing lessons.
passionate.zh: 她对教学充满激情,周末都在备课。

adventurous.en: I'm not very adventurous, so I usually order the same food every time.
adventurous.zh: 我不太爱冒险,所以每次都点同样的食物。

cautious.en: I'm a cautious driver, especially when the roads are wet.
cautious.zh: 我开车很谨慎,尤其是路面湿滑的时候。

decisive.en: A good leader needs to be decisive when things go wrong.
decisive.zh: 出问题时,好的领导者需要果断。

stubborn.en: My grandfather is so stubborn that he refuses to use a mobile phone.
stubborn.zh: 我爷爷特别固执,就是不肯用手机。

knowledgeable.en: My history teacher is really knowledgeable and can answer almost any question.
knowledgeable.zh: 我的历史老师知识渊博,几乎什么问题都能回答。

well-informed.en: I read the news every morning because I like to stay well-informed.
well-informed.zh: 我每天早上看新闻,因为我喜欢保持消息灵通。

talented.en: My friend is a really talented singer who has performed on television.
talented.zh: 我的朋友是一位很有才华的歌手,还上过电视。

charismatic.en: My favourite teacher was so charismatic that everyone listened whenever she spoke.
charismatic.zh: 我最喜欢的老师特别有魅力,她一开口大家都认真听。

influential.en: My mum has been the most influential person in my life so far.
influential.zh: 到目前为止,我妈妈是对我人生最有影响力的人。

inspiring.en: I find her story really inspiring because she started with almost nothing.
inspiring.zh: 我觉得她的故事很鼓舞人心,因为她几乎是白手起家。

admirable.en: I think it's admirable that she looks after her parents and works full-time.
admirable.zh: 她既全职工作又照顾父母,我觉得令人钦佩。

supportive.en: My family has always been very supportive of my decision to study abroad.
supportive.zh: 我的家人一直很支持我出国留学的决定。

approachable.en: My manager is very approachable, so I can ask her about anything.
approachable.zh: 我的经理很平易近人,所以我什么都可以问她。

strict.en: My parents were quite strict with me when I was at school.
strict.zh: 我上学时,父母对我挺严格的。

get-along-with.en: I get along with most of my colleagues, so work is pretty enjoyable.
get-along-with.zh: 我和大多数同事相处融洽,所以工作挺愉快的。

capable.en: She's a very capable manager who always gets things done on time.
capable.zh: 她是一位很有能力的经理,总能按时把事情办好。

alert.en: I need a strong coffee in the morning to feel alert at work.
alert.zh: 我早上需要一杯浓咖啡,上班才觉得清醒警觉。

aspiring.en: My cousin is an aspiring actor who goes to auditions almost every week.
aspiring.zh: 我的表弟是一位有抱负的演员,几乎每周都去试镜。

disciplined.en: You have to be very disciplined to study on your own at home.
disciplined.zh: 要在家自学,你得非常自律。

dependable.en: He's a really dependable friend who always turns up when he says he will.
dependable.zh: 他是个非常可靠的朋友,说来就一定会来。

discreet.en: I can tell her any secret because she's always very discreet.
discreet.zh: 我什么秘密都可以告诉她,因为她总是很谨慎。

expressive.en: My friend has a very expressive face, so I always know how she feels.
expressive.zh: 我朋友的脸很有表现力,所以我总能看出她的感受。

imaginative.en: My son is very imaginative and loves making up his own stories.
imaginative.zh: 我儿子很有想象力,喜欢自己编故事。

faithful.en: Our old dog was a faithful friend to my family for fifteen years.
faithful.zh: 我们的老狗十五年来一直是我们家忠实的朋友。

tolerant.en: My parents are quite tolerant and let me make my own choices.
tolerant.zh: 我父母很宽容,让我自己作选择。

courageous.en: I think it was courageous of her to move abroad on her own.
courageous.zh: 我觉得她独自出国很勇敢。

thrifty.en: My mum is very thrifty and always looks for the cheapest prices.
thrifty.zh: 我妈妈很节俭,总是找最便宜的价格。

frugal.en: As a student, I had to be frugal and cook most of my meals.
frugal.zh: 上学时我不得不节俭,大多自己做饭。

unselfish.en: She's the most unselfish person I know and always puts others first.
unselfish.zh: 她是我认识的最无私的人,总是把别人放在第一位。

frank.en: To be frank, I don't think I'd enjoy living in a big city.
frank.zh: 坦率地说,我觉得自己不会喜欢住在大城市。

outspoken.en: My aunt is very outspoken and always says exactly what she thinks.
outspoken.zh: 我阿姨说话直言不讳,总是想什么就说什么。

upright.en: My grandfather was an upright man who never told a single lie.
upright.zh: 我爷爷是个正直的人,从没说过一句谎话。

caring.en: My mum is such a caring person, always worrying about everybody else.
caring.zh: 我妈妈是个很有爱心的人,总是为别人操心。

affectionate.en: Our cat is very affectionate and sleeps on my bed every night.
affectionate.zh: 我们的猫很黏人,每晚都睡在我床上。

charming.en: He's a charming man, and everyone at work seems to like him.
charming.zh: 他是个迷人的人,公司里每个人好像都喜欢他。

chatty.en: My neighbour is really chatty, so it takes ages to walk past her door.
chatty.zh: 我的邻居特别健谈,所以经过她家门口总要聊好久。

precocious.en: My niece is a precocious child who could read before she started school.
precocious.zh: 我的侄女是个早熟的孩子,上学前就会读书了。

respectable.en: My parents wanted me to have a respectable job like a doctor or teacher.
respectable.zh: 我父母希望我有一份体面的工作,比如医生或老师。

mild.en: My dad is a mild man who hardly ever raises his voice.
mild.zh: 我爸爸性情温和,几乎从不提高嗓门。

mild.en: I only had a mild cold, so I still went to work.
mild.zh: 我只是轻微感冒,所以还是去上班了。

passive.en: I used to be quite passive in class and never asked any questions.
passive.zh: 我以前上课挺被动的,从不提问。

conservative.en: My grandparents are quite conservative about what young people should wear.
conservative.zh: 我的祖父母对年轻人的穿着观念挺保守的。

aggressive.en: Some drivers in my city get really aggressive during the rush hour.
aggressive.zh: 我们城市的一些司机在高峰期特别有攻击性。

cunning.en: The main character in the book is a cunning young man who tricks everyone.
cunning.zh: 书里的主人公是个狡猾的年轻人,谁都骗。

greedy.en: I felt a bit greedy after eating the last three pieces of cake.
greedy.zh: 吃完最后三块蛋糕后,我觉得自己有点贪吃。

indolent.en: I can get a bit indolent on holiday and just lie around all day.
indolent.zh: 度假时我会有点懒,整天就躺着。

cowardly.en: I felt cowardly for not telling my friend the truth.
cowardly.zh: 我没有告诉朋友真相,觉得自己很胆小。

extravagant.en: I think it's extravagant to spend that much money on a pair of shoes.
extravagant.zh: 我觉得花那么多钱买一双鞋太奢侈了。

temperamental.en: My boss can be quite temperamental, so we're careful what we say.
temperamental.zh: 我的老板有时喜怒无常,所以我们说话很小心。

optimist.en: I'm an optimist, so I always think that things will get better.
optimist.zh: 我是个乐观主义者,总觉得事情会好起来。

pessimist.en: My friend is a real pessimist who always expects the worst.
pessimist.zh: 我的朋友是个十足的悲观主义者,总是往最坏处想。

loyal.en: She's been a loyal friend to me for more than twenty years.
loyal.zh: 二十多年来,她一直是我忠诚的朋友。

suspicious.en: My grandfather is a bit suspicious of anything he buys online.
suspicious.zh: 我爷爷对网上买的东西都有点疑心。

suspicious.en: I got a suspicious email last week, so I deleted it straight away.
suspicious.zh: 我上周收到一封可疑的邮件,就马上删掉了。

eccentric.en: My uncle is a bit eccentric and keeps dozens of birds in his flat.
eccentric.zh: 我叔叔有点古怪,在公寓里养了几十只鸟。

genius.en: I'm no genius at maths, but I can manage my own money.
genius.zh: 我不是数学天才,但能管好自己的钱。

brilliant.en: My friend is a brilliant cook, and her food is better than any restaurant's.
brilliant.zh: 我朋友是个杰出的厨师,她做的菜比任何餐馆都好吃。

cynical.en: I've become a bit cynical about what politicians promise.
cynical.zh: 我对政客的承诺变得有点愤世嫉俗了。

sceptical.en: I'm sceptical about diets that promise quick results.
sceptical.zh: 我对那些承诺见效快的减肥法持怀疑态度。

companion.en: My dog has been my faithful companion on long walks for years.
companion.zh: 多年来,我的狗一直是我长途散步的忠实同伴。

appearance.en: I don't think you should judge people by their appearance.
appearance.zh: 我认为不应该以貌取人。

attractive.en: I find people with a good sense of humour really attractive.
attractive.zh: 我觉得有幽默感的人特别有吸引力。

good-looking.en: My cousin is very good-looking and could easily be a model.
good-looking.zh: 我表弟长得很好看,完全可以当模特。

handsome.en: My dad was very handsome when he was young, judging by the photos.
handsome.zh: 从照片看,我爸爸年轻时很英俊。

elegant.en: My mum always looks elegant, even when she's just going to the shops.
elegant.zh: 我妈妈总是很优雅,即使只是去商店也一样。

graceful.en: I love watching ballet because the dancers are so graceful.
graceful.zh: 我喜欢看芭蕾,因为舞者们非常优美。

slim.en: She's tall and slim, with long dark hair and big brown eyes.
slim.zh: 她又高又苗条,一头乌黑的长发,棕色的大眼睛。

slender.en: My friend has long, slender fingers, which are perfect for playing the piano.
slender.zh: 我朋友的手指又长又纤细,非常适合弹钢琴。

plump.en: My grandmother was a plump, smiling woman who loved to cook for us.
plump.zh: 我奶奶是个丰满爱笑的人,很喜欢给我们做饭。

stocky.en: My uncle is short and stocky, but he's really strong.
stocky.zh: 我叔叔个子矮、身材壮实,但力气很大。

muscular.en: My neighbour goes to the gym every day and is very muscular.
muscular.zh: 我的邻居每天去健身房,肌肉很发达。

athletic.en: She's very athletic and plays almost every sport you can think of.
athletic.zh: 她很健壮,几乎你能想到的运动她都玩。

medium-height.en: He's of medium height, with short black hair and glasses.
medium-height.zh: 他中等身高,留着黑色短发,戴着眼镜。

complexion.en: She has a lovely clear complexion, even though she never wears make-up.
complexion.zh: 她肤色清透好看,虽然从不化妆。

freckles.en: As a child, I had lots of freckles on my nose and cheeks.
freckles.zh: 我小时候鼻子和脸颊上有很多雀斑。

wrinkle.en: My mum has a few wrinkles now, but her smile still looks young.
wrinkle.zh: 我妈妈现在有几条皱纹了,但她的笑容依然年轻。

beard.en: My dad has had a beard for as long as I can remember.
beard.zh: 从我记事起,我爸爸就留着胡须。

curly.en: I've got curly hair, which is really hard to control in wet weather.
curly.zh: 我的头发是卷的,潮湿的天气里特别难打理。

straight-hair.en: My best friend has long straight hair down to her waist.
straight-hair.zh: 我最好的朋友有一头齐腰的长直发。

ponytail.en: She usually ties her hair back in a ponytail when she goes running.
ponytail.zh: 她跑步时通常把头发扎成马尾辫。

casual.en: I usually wear casual clothes like jeans and a T-shirt at weekends.
casual.zh: 周末我通常穿牛仔裤和 T 恤这样的休闲装。

formal.en: I hardly ever wear formal clothes, except for weddings and interviews.
formal.zh: 除了婚礼和面试,我几乎不穿正式的衣服。

fashionable.en: I'm not very fashionable, and I just wear what feels comfortable.
fashionable.zh: 我不太时髦,穿舒服就行。

trendy.en: There are lots of trendy cafés and shops in that part of town.
trendy.zh: 城里那一带有很多新潮的咖啡馆和商店。

stylish.en: My aunt is always stylish, even though she doesn't spend much on clothes.
stylish.zh: 我阿姨总是很有型,虽然她在衣服上花钱不多。

outfit.en: I bought a new outfit for my best friend's wedding last summer.
outfit.zh: 去年夏天,我为最好朋友的婚礼买了一套新衣服。

accessory.en: A nice scarf is my favourite accessory because it goes with everything.
accessory.zh: 漂亮的围巾是我最喜欢的配饰,因为它什么都能搭。

forehead.en: He has a high forehead and looks a lot like his father.
forehead.zh: 他的额头很高,长得很像他爸爸。

eyebrow.en: My friend has really thick eyebrows, which make her look serious.
eyebrow.zh: 我朋友的眉毛很浓,让她看起来很严肃。

eyelash.en: My baby niece has very long eyelashes, and everyone comments on them.
eyelash.zh: 我的小侄女睫毛很长,大家都夸。

moustache.en: My grandfather wore a small moustache for most of his life.
moustache.zh: 我爷爷一生大部分时间都留着小胡子。

bald.en: My dad started going bald when he was only about thirty.
bald.zh: 我爸爸才三十岁左右就开始秃头了。

blond.en: My cousin has blond hair, which is quite unusual in my family.
blond.zh: 我的表妹是金发,这在我家很少见。

skinny.en: I was really skinny as a teenager, no matter how much I ate.
skinny.zh: 我十几岁时特别瘦,怎么吃都不胖。

feminine.en: She likes wearing feminine clothes, like long dresses and soft colours.
feminine.zh: 她喜欢穿女性化的衣服,比如长裙和柔和的颜色。

well-built.en: The new security guard at my office is tall and well-built.
well-built.zh: 我们办公室新来的保安又高又壮。

well-dressed.en: My manager is always well-dressed, even on casual Fridays at work.
well-dressed.zh: 我的经理总是穿着讲究,哪怕是公司的休闲星期五也一样。

masculine.en: Some people think that cooking isn't masculine, but I completely disagree.
masculine.zh: 有些人认为做饭没有男子气概,但我完全不同意。

gorgeous.en: The view from our hotel room was absolutely gorgeous at sunset.
gorgeous.zh: 日落时,从酒店房间看到的景色美极了。
